about: The hand-curated core of the Detect features database. Each part is read from the NCBI record named by `accession`: `select` picks one of the record's features by key and qualifiers, `location` gives a GenBank location, `probe` a known sequence that must occur exactly once in the record. Run `node scripts/build-feature-db.mjs` after editing.
